description.narrative: Insight and Engagement is one of the Global Programmes through which the British Council delivers its grant-funded activity. The primary focus of this Global Programme is ODA eligible activity and outcomes. The Insight and Engagement Global Programme supports the global education sector through the brokering of connections, partnerships, thought leadership and student mobility. The programme has two main areas of focus the Going Global education conference series and the Education Insight hubs. ◼ 1. Going Global is a conference for leaders in international education to debate the future of tertiary education. The Going Global conference will provide a platform to foster engagement with, and learn about, regional and global challenges in tertiary education; and identify ways in which regional and international collaboration can strengthen capacity at system, institutional and individual level, ultimately contributing to improved outcomes for young people. The conference and affiliated regional events provide a unique space for knowledge sharing, connecting local, national, regional and global agendas. ◼ 2. The regional Insight hubs will support international student mobility as well as supporting the UK and British Council’s aim to increase system to system partnerships and help to create environments which enable further UK engagement. Outputs will inform and support our wider dialogues and connections aimed at developing global learning about tertiary education.
The audience for this programme is:◼Education stakeholders.

◼ 1. Increased number of partnerships (including research) with the UK.◼ 2. Improved opportunities for internationalisation of tertiary education sectors. Alongside UK institutions, regional institutions will also benefit from the same benefits of internationalisation: quality, international reputation, and advantages associated with collaboration and engagement at policy level.◼ 3. Insights and thought leadership will be shared with partners globally.◼ 4. Participation in regional and global events, giving the opportunity to learn about global trends and advances within Higher Education (HE) and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET). The impact we can achieve with delivery will continue to have significant impact to the sector.

title.narrative: Insights and Engagement Global Programme - Theory of Change

description.narrative: This document is a Theory of Change for the Global Programme. It summarises the theory of how the Global Programme’s intervention is expected to work and the steps involved in achieving the desired outcomes and impact.

This evaluation report is for a single project within the Global Programme, and provides an example of activity delivered under the programme. It does not cover all activity across the Global Programme.
